'''2003 New Zealand National Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG national championship held at Historic Games on 4 May 2003.<ref name="pc-intl03">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Nationals and Provincials (International Events)], swccgpc.com (2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040621085705/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Internet Archive]</ref> [[Luke Badger]] was the tournament director.<ref name="pc-intl03" />

The [[Players Committee]]'s 2003 State, Provincial and National Championships were the Level 1 events of its 2003 Championship Circuit; each awarded a bye into the [[2003 World Championship|World Championships]].<ref name="pc-champ0206">[http://www.swccgpc.com/News/championshipnews02062003.htm 2003 Championship Circuit Opens in One Month], swccgpc.com (6 February 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20030424053234/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/championshipnews02062003.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' New Zealand
* '''Dates:''' 4 May 2003<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Venue:''' Historic Games<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Time:''' 11am<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Fee:''' $10<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Luke Badger]]<ref name="pc-intl03" />
